title: skillpack selection config (skillpack.json)
description: The packs a project installs and how each agent is filled in each harness. Lives at the project root and is committed. Holds nothing machine-specific: models are in skillpack.models.json.

$schema.description: Schema URL. Its /v<N>/ folder sets the format version; a file without $schema is read as v1.

packs.description: Installed packs, keyed by normalized source: https://<host>/<owner>/<repo> or git@<host>:<owner>/<repo>, without a trailing .git or /.

version.description: Requested version: a semver version, a range, a tag, a branch or a commit SHA. add writes ^<latest tag>, or the default branch if the pack has no tags. update stays within it; upgrade rewrites it.

harnesses.description: Harnesses the pack is installed for.

skills.description: Skills to install: "*" for all, or a list of skill names from the pack.

scope.description: Scope to install under instead of the manifest name. Set by --as.

agents.description: Binding per agent and harness. Agents or harnesses left out are bound to generate.

opencode.description: generate, none, or a built-in OpenCode subagent.

codex.description: generate, none, or a built-in Codex agent.

name.description: Skill or agent name as written in the pack: lowercase letters and digits separated by single - or _.
